announcements.title: How's Steady working for you?
announcements.body: I'm a solo developer and a fellow T1D, and your feedback shapes what I build next. It only takes a minute — thank you!

announcements.title: Do you want the robots' perspective?
announcements.body: I've downloaded my Steady data and fed it to AI to get insights and recommendations.  I even had it generate a successful insurance appeal based on my data.  I'm interested in learning if Steady users would want that build in.
